name: Shiori
message: "So this is the place Kashima Reiko-san told us about..."

name: Shiori
message: "There it is, the red envelope."

name: Shiori
message: "Wow... it's just lying there. It's so conspicuous, it feels almost contrived."

name: Shiori
message: "But look... that person just walked past it without batting an eye."

name: Shiori
message: "My guess is that it's only visible to people who can see these things, like you."

name: Shiori
message: "Traditionally, only a man can pick up the ghost marriage invitation, but nyaow—"

name: Shiori
message: "Nyaow—"

name: Shiori
message: "Nyaaow itsh—GAH! Geez, I'll just start over."

name: Shiori
message: "But now that it's taken the form of an urban legend, age and gender might not matter anymore."

name: Shiori
message: "...I have a bad feeling about this. If you pick it up, something unpleasant is definitely going to happen."
(Leave)
(Draw closer)

name: Shiori
message: "Right. Let's just report to Kashima Reiko-san that we found the envelope."

name: Shiori
message: "No... someone else who can see it might pick it up."

name: Shiori
message: "Wait here for a moment."

name: Shiori
message: "There, I picked it up. This is way too dangerous to leave lying around like that."

name: Shiori
message: "If a dead person picks it up, then nothing should hap—"

name: Shiori
message: "...Okay, that made me jump. I think... that's the ghost's family."

name: Shiori
message: "They're angry."

name: Shiori
message: "Really angry. We must've ruined their daughter's ghost marriage."

name: Shiori
message: "But that's it, I guess. They don't seem like they're going to attack."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go deliver this to Kashima Reiko-san. Who knows what they'll do if I keep holding onto it? They'll probably curse me."

name: Shiori
message: "Um, well then... If you'll excuse us..."

name: Shiori
message: "Come on, hurry. They might start coming after us any second now... Hurry, come on!"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? You want a closer look? Nothing ever fazes you, doesn't it?"

name: Shiori
message: "Whatever you do, don't pick it up, okay? Be sure to keep your curiosity in check, alright?"
My head feels heavy.
Something's... pushing its way in...
The envelope.........
I need that envelope..................
(Pick up the red envelope)
(Wait for 3 seconds)
(Pick up the red envelope)
(Resist)

name: Shiori
message: "Huh? Wait! Don't—"
(Try again)
(Return to Title Screen)

name: Shiori
message: "Hey... are you okay? You're acting strange."

name: Shiori
message: "Did... something get to you?"

name: Shiori
message: "...Step back for now. Leave the rest to me."

name: Shiori
message: "There, it's fine now. I picked up the envelope."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... it must've been them. They didn't even appear until I picked up the envelope."

name: Shiori
message: "Sorry, but my buddy isn't joining your family. I'll be taking this envelope now."

name: Shiori
message: "Looks like they're angry at us for ruining their daughter's ghost marriage, but they don't look like they're going to attack."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, mission complete. We shouldn't stay here long... Let's take this to Kashima Reiko-san."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Is this...?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, the red envelope."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I never thought you'd actually bring it back."

name: Shiori
message: "It would've been dangerous if we just left it there, so I picked it up."

name: Shiori
message: "The family was reaaaally angry with me, though. They were staring a hole right through me."

name: Shiori
message: "I think this envelope can hypnotize anyone who can see it. It did some weird stuff to my buddy here."

name: Shiori
message: "If we'd left it there, someone else might've gotten hurt, so I picked it up."

name: Shiori
message: "Thanks to that, the family was absolutely furious. Like, super, super angry."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "The family?"

name: Shiori
message: "They felt... different from normal ghosts. They were more like urban-legend aberrations, neither human nor ghost."

name: Shiori
message: "A woman who looked like a bride, and her family. They just glared at us. That was all—just glaring."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "So it wasn't just the envelope. Even the ghost bride and her family had manifested as aberrations."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "It seems the urban legend has taken on a very distorted form... Interesting."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Can I have that envelope?"

name: Shiori
message: "Of course. Here."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "My thanks. Another addition to my collection."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Also, if you verify anything about Mary-san, be sure to report back."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "You're not obligated to, of course."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, I understand. Although, it does sound dangerous, so I'm a little hesitant..."
"Probably."
"Still thinking."
"Probably not."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...Do as you wish. How you use the information I've provided is up to you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "...You're quite proactive in your urban-legend investigations."

name: Shiori
message: "Part of it is because my buddy here isn't afraid of anything. Though I guess it's also because I like the occult."

name: Shiori
message: "Half of me doesn't want to put my buddy in danger, but the other half really wants to know what happens next..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I understand. I'm the same."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "However..."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I guess I'm hardly in a position to lecture you."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "I'll have a new urban legend ready next time."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, please."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Now go. With this cursed red envelope in my hands, the blight on this place has only grown stronger."

name: Kashima, Reiko
message: "Leave before the beasts of the everdark tear you two apart."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, see you again."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, Kashima Reiko-san looked really pleased."

name: Shiori
message: "Now that we've finished reporting in, we should get back to our investigation."
